functions.name: getListPercent
functions.description: Get the message-list width percentage for a mail tab in vertical layout, or null when unavailable.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Mail tab to inspect; -1 means the front mail window.

functions.name: setListPercent
functions.description: Set the message-list width percentage for a mail tab in vertical layout.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Mail tab to resize; -1 means the front mail window.

parameters.name: percent
parameters.description: Desired message-list width from 10 through 90 percent.
